questions.q: What does a flow-matching network learn to output, given x_t and t?
options: The velocity of the specific pair it came from
The average of ε − x_0 over all pairs passing through that point
questions.answer: The average of ε − x_0 over all pairs passing through that point
questions.why: It cannot see the pair, so least squares returns the conditional mean, u(x, t).

questions.q: Why is one Euler step not exact for a normal flow-matching model?
options: Euler is not allowed on ODEs
The marginal field changes along the path, so the path curves
questions.answer: The marginal field changes along the path, so the path curves
questions.why: The lab measures an RMS velocity change of 2.61 along paths, and a one-step error of 1.67.

questions.q: What do Liu et al. prove about the rectified coupling?
options: It does not increase convex transport costs
It is always the optimal transport map
It removes the need for an ODE
questions.answer: It does not increase convex transport costs
questions.why: Non-increasing cost in general. It coincides with the optimum only in special cases such as this 1-D lab.
